gloss: informal dress; semi-formal attire; simplified outfit

definitions.gloss: informal dress; semi-formal attire; simplified outfit
definitions.explanation: Clothing that is less formal than full formal dress but still appropriate for the occasion. Used when an event or situation does not require full ceremonial or business attire.

examples.japanese: {略装|りゃくそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{越|こ}し→お越し：07322_okoshi⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{式|しき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{略装|りゃくそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{構|かま}いません。
examples.english: Semi-formal dress is fine for the ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{招待状|しょうたいじょう}→招待状：14769_shoutaijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「{略装|りゃくそう}⟦にて→〜にて：21803_nite⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いてあった→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ネクタイ→ネクタイ：01040_nekutai⟧なし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}した→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧。
examples.english: The invitation said 'semi-formal attire,' so I attended in a suit without a tie.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{略|りゃく}→略：21443_ryaku⟧ (abbreviation; simplification) and {装|そう} (clothing; outfit). Commonly appears on invitations and event notices as a dress code indicator. In Japanese etiquette, {略装|りゃくそう} means the attendee need not wear the most formal version of attire — for men, this typically means a suit without a tie; for women, a smart outfit that is not a full formal gown.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {略装|りゃくそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{越|こ}し→お越し：07322_okoshi⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧: please come in informal attire
- {略装|りゃくそう}⟦にて→〜にて：21803_nite⟧: in informal dress (written on invitations)
- {略装|りゃくそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧: to attend in semi-formal attire

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{正装|せいそう}→正装：16053_seisou⟧: full formal dress — the most formal level of attire for ceremonies
- {平服|へいふく}: everyday clothes; informal dress — often appears on invitations and can cause confusion since it actually means 'smart casual' rather than truly casual wear
- ⟦カジュアル→カジュアル：09595_kajuaru⟧: casual — the most relaxed dress code, borrowed from English
